editionLabel: English Brain Games rules, ten-page publisher download
location: Setup step 5; Phase 2, playing the round; two-player changes
firstPlayerRule: Whoever saw a penguin most recently is the first catcher. The player to that person's left takes the first flick, and turns continue clockwise.
clarifications: The catcher assignment does not make that person the first player to move. In a four-player round, the three runners act before the catcher.
The two-player rules keep this starting order.
evidenceNotes: English PDF pages 2, 4 and 10 (printed 5, 7 and 13) were rendered and inspected. The publisher rules index links the public Google Drive download. German AMIGO PDF pages 3, 5 and 11 were also visually checked and agree on the starting instructions. The English source replaces the temporary German-only draft; these matching instructions are represented once in the directory.

editionLabel: English Green edition, Brain Games rules with 2019 copyright
location: Overview and Game Setup; Playing a Round; TEAM3VS3 variant
firstPlayerRule: For the cooperative base game, the player with the longest arms is the first Architect. The next player to the left is the Supervisor, followed by the Builder.
clarifications: This assigns the opening team roles. The Architect starts the timer and gestures to the Supervisor while the three players work together.
In the competitive TEAM3VS3 variant, teams race simultaneously; there is no team that moves first.
evidenceNotes: Green cover and Mind Merge expansion identify the edition. Rendered PDF pages 1, 3 and 4 were inspected, including the 2019 copyright and simultaneous competitive variant. No criterion for an individual Builder turn was inferred.
